verdict.rationale: Rive serves its documentation as agent-friendly markdown: the .md docs page returned HTTP 200 and opens with a 'Documentation Index' that points agents to https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt. However, the root https://rive.app/llms.txt returns 404, and the docs-level llms.txt is only referenced, never fetched or verified. Missing for 10: a verified, reachable llms.txt (the root path 404s and the docs path is unconfirmed), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent can consume these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://rive.app/docs/llms.txt
